Steytlerville Follies

By: Stenette Grosskopf | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
A unique theatrical experience in the middle of the Karoo

Unique Selling Point:
It smacks of "Pricilla, Queen of the Desert" (for those old enough to remember it) — Mark Hinds and Jacques Rabie, a couple of middle aged white gentlemen gave up their lives in the city and decided to move to the sleepy Karoo Town of Steytlerville. They discovered a little hotel, which they bought and restored, the Karroo Theatrical Hotel - an oasis in the desert.... and they entertain their guests with a one-of-a-kind drag show... in the middle of the Karoo!

Summary:
Mark has a background in theatre and worked in the circus as a white-faced clown for many years across Europe. Jacques was working in the corporate world in Cape Town. They met at Hinds’ little theatre in De Waterkant and fell in love. In 2003 they moved to Tulbach, enjoying the countryside. Then an advert in the newspaper drew their attention, a derelict building in… Steytlerville.

They took great care to restore the old building and today it is a beautiful victorian-esque haven… But the big attraction at their hotel is the Steytlerville Follies. By day Mark and Jacques run their hotel, and by night… they transform into Dame Layla Lamborgini and Freddie Ferrari and entertain guest with excerpts from the musicals, classical song and dance. Jacques designs and makes all their costumes, and choreographs the drag shows, and is also the main performer, while Mark accompanies on piano.

They are absolute characters!

They even inherited custody of an eccentric old lady’s “son” — a ventriloquist dummy and now Charlie (the puppet) is part of the show.

Their lives are filled with stories and laughter.

STEYTLERVILLE FOLLIES – SCRIPT FINAL




UPSOUND
My job, ek maak mense lag, ek laat hulle huil…



Jy ry saam met die mense daai emotional rollercoaster want jy gaan deur dieselfde emosies…

Ons almal het ‘n storietjie in ons lewe om te vertel, en hierdie is nou my storie om te vertel en dis wat ek van like… vertel die mense waarvan jy hou en wie jy is.. Ons hoef nie in vandag se lewe meer skaam te wees oor wie en wat ons is nie… ons kan maar net ons self wees en dis wat lekker is
Music


V/O
It’s Valentine’s day and I am on my way to the Eastern Cape to meet a couple who found their unique place in the world … doing what they love most…


V/O
From Gqeberha the road takes us north-west to a hotel nestled between the Baviaanskloof Mountains and the Great Karoo… where my hosts, Mark Hinds and Jacques Rabie are waiting…
V/O
It’s called the Karroo Theatrical Hotel… and from the outset it is clear this is no ordinary countryside setup…
Charlie
Welcome to the Karroo Theatrical Hotel…
V/O
Charlie is but one of the reasons why this off-beat little hotel is booked to capacity over weekends…

Mark and Jacques offer a very different brand of Karoo entertainment…
Jacques and Mark
Jacques: 15 years ago we had a younger crowd here on a Saturday night and then they wanted to book a New Year's party and they wanted a cross-dressing party. So we said, fine, you can book the new year’s party.
Mark: Sort of a Rocky Horror theme.
Jacques: And they said don’t I want to do a cross-dressing show for them. And I said what? They said, ja.. Please please…
Mark: A drag show.
Jacques: So I said well if you collect enough money amongst each other so I can buy the stuff that I need to do the show with, I’ll with biggest pleasure do it. But I’ll do it for one night, and one night only… It’s now 15 years later and we’re still doing it one night only…


V/O
That was the birth of the Steytlerville Follies…


Mark & Jacques
Jacques: My name is Dame Layla Lamborgini… and Mark is…
Mark: Freddie Ferrari


V/O
Having met in Cape Town in the early 2000’s, Mark & Jacques decided to pack in city-life, in search of something more meaningful…
Mark
I then saw an ad which said, Hotel for sale in the Eastern Cape. We both wanted to live in a massive, big mansion of a home, and this just sounded perfect for us.
And as we came around the sharp bend at top, we stopped the car and we both actually fell in love…
V/O
Years of hard work has transformed the once derelict building into this gem overlooking the town of Steytlerville.
Mark & Jacques
Derek: What about the good residents of Steytlerville, did they take to this?

Jacques: In the beginning they were not too keen on men like us moving into town, but after the first matric farewell dress that I designed and made everybody loved us…
V/O
Despite his weakness for sequins, Jacques spent most of his life in the corporate world… and he has the South African Military to thank for his sewing skills.
Jacques
I was working for the correctional services and to become a lieutenant you either have to have a degree or a diploma, but they never stipulated what you must study. So I did a course in Fashion design and dressmaking.
V/O
A handy skill for a Karoovian Diva…
Jacques & Derek:
Jacques: I make all the costumes and it’s a passion of mine.

Derek: Keeps you busy?

Jacques: Oh yes, I love doing it. Especially with all this sequins and embroidery on them… most of my dresses I hand-embroider…
Mark & Jacques
Jacques: I mean I love cooking, I love doing garden work, and I love doing this… It’s not a job! I always say if something is your passion then it’s not work. I mean it’s like… if Mark plays the piano. He plays the piano every day of his life. It’s a passion…
Mark & Jacques
Life before Jacques… Married to the piano
V/O
He even spent time as a circus clown performing across Europe.
Mark
Mark: To go from the archetype of white-face clown in the circus to pairing up with a drag artist is a pretty big step.

Derek: You've been married before?

Mark: Never been married… Married to the piano… yeah…
V/O
In fact, Mark has built up quite a collection of pianos over the years…
Mark & Jacques


Derek: And you think you might at some stage run out of pianos?

Jacques; No.

Mark: It’s always a big worry, it’s always a big worry. I’ve always got my eye on whatever is out there on the market. I get reprimanded quite often about that because I am always on the verge of getting a truck and …

Derek: Is this your weakness? You’ll buy a piano anywhere?

Mark: Ja.

Derek: How many you got now?

Mark: I’ve got 14 pianos altogether.
Derek: 14, but space for a few more… I mean there’s…

Mark: Oh yeah, one can always build on…


V/O
But pianos are not Mark’s only passion… he has a soft spot for antiques, art … and vintage cars…
Mark & Jaques


Mark: She is rather beautiful, elegant lady… she is…

Jacques: Princess Betty

Mark: Princess Betty.

Derek: And what is Princess Betty?

Mark: Princess Betty is a Vanden Plas.

Derek: I remember them from Bullawayo.

Mark: Do you?

Derek: Yes.

Mark: the big round voluptuous ones.

Derek: Mainly for the rich folk.

Mark: yeah.



V/O
And what better way to explore the town of Steytlerville, than in this beautifully restored 1963 classic.
MArk
A.G. Visser, the poet, lived in that house…
V/O
The town was established in 1876 by the Dutch Reformed church to provide spiritual guidance to the local farmers of the area.

The original church was later rebuilt and is considered to be, the largest Edwardian church in Southern Africa.
MArk
And that’s why we’ve got this big wide main road, so that the oxwagons could turn easily. And of course the bulk of the houses were nagmaal huisies…
V/O
Many of these original communion houses have been restored as more and more people are drawn by the countryside-charm… putting towns like Steytlerville back on the tourist map…
UPSOUND
Look at that, it’s been beautifully restored… recently sold to Germans, in fact…
V/O
Back at the hotel we find Jacques in the dressing room, undergoing a transformation… under the watchful eye, of Charlie…
Jacques
Ek moet nou die maniere aanleer, binne die volgende paar minute, van vrouwees.
V/O
Years of practice makes it all look so effortless…
Jacques
Ek skep nog al die kos op in die aande voor die show. Ek moet vinnig hardloop hiernatoe papnat gesweet. Vinnig moet jy afdroog, afkoel, gesig afdroog en regmaak.



LINK


It’s been a long day and after hearing so much about it I can’t wait to finally watch the show.
Jacques
Elke show het ‘n ander tema. As jy die songs bymekaar bring en jy luister na die woorde dan sal jy weet, Wow dit is wat Jacques probeer vertel, of wat Layla wil vir ons vertel.


Mark & Jacques…


Mark: We’ll always be reinventing ourselves, we’ll always be reinventing the pace. It’s growth, life is about growth. Growing is moving forward and the moment you stop that growth you stagnate.

Jacques: Ja and there’s still way too much sequins and glitter materials still out there in the world that still needs to be used and turned into costumes. So, we are going nowhere. …












PROMO 1 11”
It’s a one-of-a-kind show in a little theatre on the edge of the Great Karoo…

The Steytlerville Follies!
PROMO 2 21”
A quaint little hotel in the Eastern Cape countryside…

a couple who created a life filled with everything they love…

Jacques: Ons hoef nie in vandag se lewe meer skaam te wees oor wie en wat ons is nie… ons kan maar net ons self wees en dis wat lekker is




PROMO 3 21”
What one earth does one do with a little hotel in the middle of nowhere, 14 pianos and a room full of sequence?

It’s quite simple: You put on a drag show!

The Steytlerville Follies.
